desc: Derive and implement prefix-parity expressions for horizontal and vertical edge states, including cyclic consistency checks.
Formulate the parity equation for each Type B cell and verify its constant.
Implement a parity DSU with contradiction detection and component counting.
Confirm the bijection between origin-variable assignments and valid tile placements.
Produce an \(O(HW\,\alpha(H+W))\) implementation with fast I/O and modular exponentiation.
Validate the implementation on the supplied samples and relevant edge cases.
